description.zh: 一份薪水的去向：薪資分布、綜所稅、勞保與勞退、年金改革的各方說法，附四個試算工具。
description.en: Where a Taiwanese paycheck goes: the wage distribution, income tax, Labor Insurance and Labor Pension, and the pension-reform debate, with four calculators.

title.zh: 所得稅試算（115 年度，2027 年 5 月報稅）
title.en: Taiwan income tax calculator (2026 income, filed May 2027)

description.zh: 輸入薪資、扶養人數與扣除額，算出綜所稅應納稅額與最省的計稅方式，可切換 114 年度。
description.en: Enter salary, dependents and deductions to get the individual income tax due and the cheapest filing method. Switch to the 2025 tax year if needed.

title.en: Taiwan Labor Insurance and Labor Pension calculator 2026

description.zh: 輸入出生年、年資與投保薪資，算出勞保老年年金與勞退月退，比較 60 到 70 歲各年齡請領的金額。
description.en: Enter birth year, years of coverage and insured salary to estimate the Labor Insurance old-age pension and Labor Pension annuity, and compare claiming at ages 60 to 70.

title.zh: 年薪位置查詢（2024 年薪資分布）

description.zh: 輸入全年總薪資，對照主計總處受僱員工薪資十分位數，看自己落在第幾個百分位。
description.en: Enter your annual pay and see which percentile it falls in, using the official decile figures for Taiwan's employees.

title.zh: 實領薪資與雇主成本計算 2026
title.en: Taiwan take-home pay and employer cost calculator 2026

description.zh: 輸入月薪，算出勞保、就保、勞退自提與所得稅後的每月實領，以及雇主另外負擔的成本。
description.en: Enter a monthly salary to see take-home pay after Labor Insurance, Employment Insurance, voluntary pension contributions and income tax, plus what the employer pays on top.
